items.text: 7 world markets made big moves over the past week, led by US 10-year bond yield, which rose 0.29 points.
The NIFTY 500 fell 0.6% on 13 Nov. Telecommunication was the strongest sector (+0.1%) and Power the weakest (−1.2%).

Foreign investors bought a net ₹13,113 Cr of Indian shares in 16-31 Oct 2026, after selling ₹47,956 Cr in 1-15 Oct 2026. Foreign investors are quietly accumulating in 42 niches; Cables, Wires & Conductors joined today.
